units.en: This page is about the ratio, for the absolute number in a state, see ⟦0⟧, for free manpower of a country, see ⟦1⟧.

Recruitable population is a ratio that divides the population of states into available recruits and civilians. The ratio depends on laws and ideas of a country, the political situation of the respective states the country controls, and the mobilization speed. Changing conscription laws is the main way to control the ratio. Ignoring mobilization, the overall formula for a particular state is:

Recruitable ratio = ∑ ( Recruitable Population modifier ) ∗ ∑ ( Recruitable Population Factor modifier ) ∗ ∑ ( non-core modifier ) ∗ ∑ ( occupation modifier ) = ∑ ( Recruitable Population modifier + Additional Recruitable Population modifier ) ∗ ∑ ( Recruitable Population Factor modifier ) ∗ ∑ ( non-core modifier ) {\displaystyle {\begin{aligned}{\text{Recruitable ratio}}&=\sum ({\text{Recruitable Population modifier}})*\sum ({\text{Recruitable Population Factor modifier}})*\sum ({\text{non-core modifier}})*\sum ({\text{occupation modifier}})\\&=\sum ({\text{Recruitable Population modifier}}+{\text{Additional Recruitable Population modifier}})*\sum ({\text{Recruitable Population Factor modifier}})*\sum ({\text{non-core modifier}})\\\end{aligned}}}
The ⟦0⟧ modifier is mainly determined by conscription law. Some ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and other ⟦3⟧ can increase or reduce the modifier. Values stack additively.

Recruitable Population Factor refers to additional, nation-specific modifiers that are multiplicative with the recruitable percentage. These are usually penalties. For example, the USA gets ⟦0⟧ from its "Great Depression" national spirit until removed, so if it has Volunteer Only conscription law it will have an effective recruitable percentage of 0.75% (1.5% [from the law] * 50%).

Non-core states have a base penalty of ⟦0⟧. This means that the manpower of countries comes almost entirely from their core states. The ⟦1⟧ advisor gives a ⟦2⟧ offset to recruitable non-core manpower, reducing the penalty to ⟦3⟧.
Creating ⟦0⟧ states is a possibility to avoid this penalty, as the puppet will have full access to the manpower of its own cores.
If a non-core state is occupied, a further penalty of ⟦0⟧ applies, which is mitigated by compliance: ⟦1⟧
Manpower available = 100 % − 98 % + 18 % ⋅ Compliance level {\displaystyle {\text{Manpower available}}=100\%-98\%+18\%\cdot {\text{Compliance level}}}
The average compliance level between states of an occupied nation yields flat bonuses to manpower
This results in a maximum manpower pool of ⟦0⟧
